body:
## What it is

WeGoTrip sells this as a self-guided tour in Phoenix, United States. It starts at 6101 East Van Buren Street.

## How WeGoTrip describes it

> The Hall of Flame features five galleries, the National Firefighting Hall of Heroes, the museum store, a theater, and a restoration shop. There's something here for every flame-thrower or wannabe firefighter!
>
> See special fire apparatus, artwork, uniforms and equipment, alarm room equipment, and a huge fire safety exhibit which includes a two room safety house, a mini-theater, and many hands-on exhibits for children.
>
> The National Firefighting Hall of Heroes honors American firefighters who've received a national award for heroism, as well as brave American firefighters who died in the line of duty.

## Price and rating

On 13 November 2026, WeGoTrip's product data listed it from €19.84. It was rated 5.0 out of 5 from 129 ratings and 69 written reviews. The final price is shown at WeGoTrip's checkout.

## Where this page comes from

This page was built on 13 November 2026 from WeGoTrip's partner data, the product information WeGoTrip gives its affiliates. We have not taken this tour ourselves, so check the listing for anything that matters to you before you book.
